description: Evaluator-private deterministic commands for rebuilding the runtime target in gt-memory-env. These commands build artifacts only; PoC execution is described by runtime_spec.json.

commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
apt-get update >/tmp/apt.update.log 2>&1
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y autoconf automake libtool bison re2c pkg-config >/tmp/apt.install.log 2>&1
rm -rf /gt/_work/php /gt/_work/php-src /gt/_work/oniguruma /gt/_work/src/oniguruma /gt/_work/oss_src /gt/_out
mkdir -p /gt/_out
export SRC=/gt/_work/oss_src OUT=/gt/_out WORK=/gt/_work GT_OSS_FUZZ_WORKDIR=/gt/_work/src
bash /gt/oss_fuzz_setup.sh
ln -sfn /gt/_work/oss_src/oniguruma /gt/_work/src/oniguruma
cd /gt/_work/src
git config --global --add safe.directory /gt/_work/src
bash /gt/oss_fuzz_build.sh
